messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

{"chapter":9,"verses":[{"chapter":9,"verse":11,"text":"11 And after this they prepared to bury him."},{"chapter":9,"verse":12,"text":"12 And there was a voice saying: “Do not bury the one who is still alive, for his soul is returning to his body!”"},{"chapter":9,"verse":13,"text":"13 And when they heard the voice they did not bury him, but stayed around his tent for three days saying, “When will he get up?”"},{"chapter":9,"verse":14,"text":"14 And after three days his soul came back into his body and he raised his voice among them all and said: “Glorify God with one voice! All of you glorify God and the son of God who awakens us, Messiah Jesus, the light of all the ages, the inextinguishable lamp, the life of faith."},{"chapter":9,"verse":15,"text":"15 But after these times there will be 477 years more and he will come to earth."}],"book_code":"4BAR"}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return exactly source verse numbers 11,12,13,14,15 in this chapter.
